authors: Thomas M. Davis, Lisa M. Duckett, Chad E. Garvey, Jeffrey M. Hollifield, C. Stuart Patterson
title: Osmotic Coefficients of Aqueous LiCl and CaCl2 from Their Isopiestic Ratios to NaCl at 50 C
needs_pass2_reason: Text layer clean; all 60 cells matched the 200 dpi page image; no corrections.
experimental_method: Isopiestic method at 50 C with NaCl as reference salt; 20 successful equilibrations, two or three samples per salt; molalities of NaCl, LiCl and CaCl2 solutions at isopiestic equilibrium.
uncertainties_stated: Coefficient of variation of replicates below 0.1 % (weighted average 0.048 % NaCl, 0.037 % LiCl, 0.040 % CaCl2; overall 0.042 %). Uncertainty of smoothed osmotic coefficients about 0.2 % (LiCl) and 0.3 % (CaCl2).
quality_remarks: Authors report their CaCl2 osmotic coefficients disagree significantly with Ananthaswamy and Atkinson recommended values below about 0.8 m; LiCl agrees with Gibbard and Scatchard in 1-4 m. Temperature scale not stated. Table I values are experimental; Table II (smoothed osmotic coefficients derived from Pitzer NaCl reference) is derived.
not_extracted_tables: Table II (smoothed osmotic coefficients at rounded molalities, p. 55): smoothed/derived from fits and Pitzer NaCl reference.
Table III (fit parameters for R and phi): model parameters.
